_comment: Edit this file to configure music source and backgrounds. Restart server after changes.

music._comment_source: Set 'type' to 'local' or 'youtube'. Only the matching block is used.

youtube._comment: Requires yt-dlp installed on PATH. Set type to 'youtube' above and paste your playlist URL here.

backgrounds._comment: List image filenames from the /backgrounds/ folder, OR full URLs. Set intervalSeconds for how long each image shows.
